text: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか　◎くさ　じめん　ひこう　ドラゴン　△ほのお　みず　こおり　はがね

structure.jp: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか
◎くさ　じめん　ひこう　ドラゴン
structure.en: super effective: Grass, Ground, Flying, Dragon

structure.jp: △ほのお　みず　こおり　はがね
structure.en: not very effective: Fire, Water, Ice, Steel

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward', and の ties that to the next thing, so it is an effect aimed at something. あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか = 'the effect on the opposing Pokémon'.
